title: libunibreak CMake target must track upstream source list manually
body: Upstream libunibreak_5_1 has no CMake project, so this lane hand-built VixenLibunibreak and copied the eight CFILES from src/Makefile.gcc into VIXEN/dependencies/CMakeLists.txt. A reusable CMake integration or machine-readable upstream source manifest would keep the fetched library target complete across updates.

title: VIXEN preset configure and build use different working directories
body: The failed configure command was nice -n 10 env VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/textshape/.tmp/fetch cmake --preset vixen-wsl from the worktree root; CMake exited 1 because no root CMakePresets.json exists. Running it from VIXEN succeeded. The failed build command was nice -n 10 cmake --build build/wsl --target VIXEN test_text_glyph_metrics test_ui_hud_smoke test_text_shaping -j4 from VIXEN; it exited 1 because the preset stores its binary tree at worktree-root/build/wsl. Running it from the worktree root succeeded. Add a workspace-root wrapper or document the source and binary directories together so preset users do not need to infer this split.

title: VIXEN blanket data ignore hides Text test font fixtures
body: git add VIXEN/libraries/Text omitted the new test font because VIXEN/.gitignore:92 ignores every data/ directory. I had to run git add -f VIXEN/libraries/Text/tests/data/NotoSansArabic-VF.ttf to include the reproducible Arabic shaping fixture. Narrow the ignore to runtime data roots or add an exception for libraries/*/tests/data.
